notes:
Top-level summary: Halcyon is a developer-tooling company building an IDE copilot embedded into VS Code and an internal low-latency completion service. They require a fully on-prem, air-gapped deployment with signed offline updates and hardware sizing guidance. Key constraints:
- Primary workload: real-time code completion + contextual chat inside IDEs; target concurrency ~200 active devs, 20-30 reqs/sec sustained, peak bursts 80-100 reqs/sec.
- Latency SLO: prefer token generation latency <30ms for completions to preserve editor experience; streaming support essential (server->extension chunked streaming).
- Model policy: want model/version pinning, deterministic fallbacks to smaller quantized models if capacity constrained. Need support for deploying custom tuned LLMs (legal: export review).
- Packaging: must ship as offline-installable artifacts (OCI tar + signed manifest) for air-gapped installs; offline updates via signed bundle that the on-prem agent can pull from removable media.
- HW ask: two validated options proposed — 1) 4x A100 80GB nodes (primary), 2) 8x H100-80GB nodes split across two racks for HA and quantized instances. Customer prefers fewer nodes with better perf to reduce complexity.
- Persistence: KV cache persistence across restarts and safe local encryption (customer will supply HSM/KMS).
- Security: SOC2 not yet completed; ISO27001 sought. Must show audit logging, SSO (SAML), and key rotation story. Legal flagged model export controls for certain model weights — blocking production until export review completes.
- Quote from CTO (paraphrased): "We can't compromise dev flow — completions need to feel instantaneous. If you add 50ms, adoption drops."
Pilot plan: 2-week pilot for 25 developers with VS Code extension + local routing; deliver signed offline update flow and HW sizing validation. Success metrics: median completion latency <35ms, no data exfiltration in air-gap test, seamless offline update in lab.
Next steps (short): finalize hardware SKU, provide signed packaging spec, schedule legal/export call, demo offline-update workflow.
Staged blockers: procurement ETA for GPUs, legal export clearance, proof of signed-package verification on Halcyon's air-gapped cluster.
